title: [finding] app branding.logo is authored by the designer and documented, but no mounted component renders it since AppSidebar (never mounted) was removed
body:
Filing gate: **① a declared key with measured producers and no runtime reader** (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove; the direction is ENFORCE per objectstack triage).
- `reach:` named producers on objectui `main` `fb91ac9b0`:
  - `packages/plugin-designer/src/AppCreationWizard.tsx:616` writes `branding.logo` (`value={branding.logo ?? ''}`). Per objectstack#20146, plugin-designer's `BrandingEditor` also writes it with a preview, and `EditAppPage` pre-fills it;
  - downstream, `objectstack-ai/hotcrm`'s `crm.app.ts` sets it, as objectstack#20146 records;
  - the published `@object-ui/app-shell` CHANGELOG tells authors to set `branding.logo` on the app schema.
- **Rendered by nothing that ships.** `AppSidebar.tsx`, never mounted, was the only component that read it, and PR #10617 (#5817) removed it. The console renders `UnifiedSidebar`. `AppSchemaRenderer` reads a top-level `logo`, not `branding.logo`.
  - `wizardDraftToAppSchema` (`packages/types/src/app.ts`) copies a wizard draft's `branding.logo` into that top-level `logo`, so only a wizard-authored logo can surface, and only in an `AppSchemaRenderer` host.
  - This seat re-read the removal on `main` (`AppSidebar.tsx` is absent at `fb91ac9b0`) and the wizard write above. It did not re-run the full reader census; that comes from objectstack#20146's contract-reviewed table.

Carrier for the objectstack ledger row `app.branding.logo` (`packages/spec/liveness/app.json`). That row moves to `planned` and names this card, in the objectstack#20146 PR. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` execution seat 1 (`session_01Rjy9MeetSfq34PKn81CRiN`, seat post objectstack#6017), as objectstack#20146's triage grade (`5832699195`) directs: 「the claiming seat files that card in objectui with a back-link」. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to objectui triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the fix is (for the dispatch to confirm)

- A mounted component renders the app's `branding.logo`: `UnifiedSidebar`'s header or `AppShell`'s branding (`useAppShellBranding`, which already carries `primaryColor` from `ConsoleLayout`).
- When it lands, the objectstack ledger row flips `planned` → `live`, citing this reader at the `.objectui-sha` pin that carries it.
- **Spelling:** objectstack's `AppSchema` declares only `branding.logo`. A top-level `logo` on an app is REFUSED: `AppSchema.safeParse` answers `unrecognized_keys` with a did-you-mean `logo → branding` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`, the suggestion table). No conversion rewrites it. So `branding.logo` is the one spelling. (Corrected 2026-09-27 from this card's first text, which said the key "folds into" `branding`. The objectstack#20146 dev measured it; see PR objectstack#20302.) The dispatch measures whether objectui's `AppSchemaRenderer` top-level `logo` read should move to `branding.logo`.

## Dedupe

A local scan of every open and recently closed objectui issue and PR for `branding.logo|branding?.logo|AppSidebar…logo|logo…(UnifiedSidebar|AppShell)` finds 1 hit: PR #10617 (the removal), which carries no renderer.
